source: markup p64 teal linear "1: REMOVE EXISTING CURB & GUTTER"
formula: LF = sum of traced curb runs
notes: Traced along the CAD curb-demolition linetype (black 0.72 pt line with full crossing ticks, ++++). CAD cross-check on C-1.0: the linetype is drawn as 7.2 pt (2.0 ft) pieces with one full crossing tick at every joint, so LF ~ crossing ticks x 2.0 ft (about 484 ticks = 967 LF). Measured along the linetype itself, the 10 site curb polylines total 975.2 LF (legend sample excluded); the estimator is +1.2% over that. Mixed 24" C&G and 24" roll curb, all on one line.

source: markup p64 red area "2: ... TWO STORY BUILDING..." + survey label "TWO STORY BUILDING"
formula: CFT = footprint SF x stories x 10 ft, rounded to nearest 10 CF
notes: Unrounded 89782.0 CF (+0.002%). The plans give no building height (the survey shows only F.F.E.= 442.2'), so the 10 ft/story is the estimator's own convention: 89780/4489.1 = 19.9996 ft. No foundation depth is added. CAD hatch polygon on C-1.0 = 4463.1 SF (+0.58% PlanSwift vs CAD).

source: markup p64 bright-green area "2: ... ONE STORY BUILDING..." + survey label "ONE STORY BUILDING"
formula: CFT = footprint SF x stories x 10 ft, rounded to nearest 10 CF
notes: Unrounded 17137.0 CF (-0.018%). 17140/1713.7 = 10.0018 ft, so the same 10 ft/story. CAD hatch outline polygon (path 1290, 5 vertices, slightly skewed) = 1716.4 SF by shoelace, about 52.1' x 32.9' effective; its bounding box is 52.4' x 32.9' = 1724.7 SF. PlanSwift vs CAD polygon -0.16%.

source: markup p64 yellow area "9: REMOVE EXISTING SIDEWALK"
formula: SF = sum of traced sidewalk areas
notes: Yellow L-shaped walk on the north and west sides of the one-storey building ("CONCRETE SIDEWALK", 3 KN9 tags). CAD cross-check on the black 0.48 pt walk outline (path 4082): L-walk closed on the building line = 331.3 SF, plus the south apron down to the gas line (880.8-898.3 x 882.2-918.7 pt) = 49.0 SF, together 380.3 SF. The yellow trace includes the apron and stops at the gas line; the dotted corner south of it is pavement (line 9). Estimator +2.6% over 380.3 SF. Thickness is not shown.

source: markup p64 periwinkle count dot "10: REMOVE EXISTING  MONUMENT SIGN"
notes: One count dot on the survey "BRICK SIGN" at the Watson Blvd frontage. The C-1.0 text layer has exactly one "10" keynote tag.

source: markup p64 magenta area "11: REMOVE EXISTING CONCRETE RAMP"
formula: SF = sum of traced ramp/sidewalk areas
notes: Two magenta areas: (a) "CONCRETE SIDEWALK/RAMP" and the north "RAMP" strip between the brick steps and the two-storey building, ending at the right-hand METAL HANDRAIL line (x = 1306.3 pt) and flaring at the curb; (b) a small pad on the west side of the one-storey building with a KN11 tag. CAD cross-check: the black 0.48 pt outline (path 5685) closed along the two-storey building outline (1147.3,1001.0)-(1183.6,1000.3)-(1269.5,1001.0)-(1269.5,1007.8) = 406.4 SF (walk strip about 340 SF + N-S ramp strip about 66 SF); pad (b) 993.6-1007.3 x 882.2-892.4 pt = 10.8 SF; CAD total 417.2 SF. The estimator is +6.0% over CAD (+6.2% on (a) alone). GPT-6 Astra reads the trace as covering the walk strip and the ramp strip up to the curb, nothing east of the rail, and the stair treads not visibly included. Keynote 11 reads "RAMP AND STAIRS"; the stairs are split out to line 8.

description: KN11 remove existing brick stair steps
source: markup p64 rose-brown count dots (7 stacked) "11: REMOVE EXISTING BRICK STAIR STEPS"
formula: EA = count of treads/risers on the drawn stair
notes: Seven translucent dots are stacked on the one "BRICK STEPS" stair north of the two-storey building, so EA = each step, not each stair. CAD: 7 grey 0.96 pt horizontal step lines across the 8.7 ft wide stair at y = 953.4, 955.7, 958.7, 961.8, 964.8, 967.8 and 973.4 pt (the last on the walk edge), with a slanted top landing edge from (1149.5,955.2) to (1180.3,940.1). The spaces are unequal: 7.7", 10.0", 10.3", 10.0", 10.0" and 18.7", so no uniform tread can be read. EA = number of drawn step lines between the top landing and the walk = 7. GPT-6 Astra independently counted 7 grey tread lines and would record 7 steps, though the plan alone does not fix a riser count. The survey also labels brick steps on the west side of the two-storey building, but those sit inside the building hatch and are not counted.

description: KN7 remove existing pavement w/ striping
source: markup p64 medium-green area "7: REMOVE EXISTING PAVEMENT W/ PAVEMENT STRIPING"
formula: SF = sum of traced pavement areas
notes: All asphalt parking lot and drive inside the curb lines, 10 KN7 tags. CAD cross-check: the "DEMOLISH EXISTING PAVEMENT" dot hatch has 4556 dots on a 7.5 x 7.5 pt (2.083 ft) staggered grid, 4.3397 SF/dot = 19,771.7 SF (-2.06%). Striping rides on the area line with no separate LF. Thickness is unknown, and there is no saw-cut line even though GDN 3 requires a full-depth saw cut at the limits.

source: markup p64 slate-blue count dots "8: REMOVE EXISTING TREES/VEGETATION"
formula: EA = count of X tree symbols (KN8)
notes: Two "X" DEMOLISH EXISTING TREE symbols on C-1.0: one by the crosstie border north of the one-storey building, and one in the PINESTRAW ISLAND on the west. There are 2 KN8 tags. No DBH is labelled, so the trees are unsized.

description: KN6 remove existing water line & structures
source: markup p64 teal linear "6: REMOVE EXISTING WATER LINE..."
formula: LF = traced length of ticked W line
notes: One E-W "W" line across the west parking lot, from the Westgate Dr. curb to the sidewalk (KN6 tags x2). CAD line from x = 696.5 to 897.5 pt = 55.83 LF (-0.41%): 10 full 18 pt (5.0 ft) linetype pieces plus two 10.4 pt ends, carrying 11 "///" tick glyphs at an 18 pt pitch (GPT-6 Astra also counts 11). The KN6 tag at the ICV south of the two-storey building has no separate LF.

description: KN5 remove existing power line & structures
source: markup p64 red linear "5: REMOVE EXISTING POWER LINE..."
formula: LF = traced length of all ticked dry-utility lines (OHP/UGP/TEL)
notes: The red traces follow every utility line drawn with the "DEMOLISH EXISTING UTILITIES" /// linetype except water and gas: the OHP/UGP fan from the pole at the north R/W (the north R/W runs and the diagonals) and the TEL loop around the east and south of the two-storey building. CAD cross-check on C-1.0: the linetype is drawn as 18 pt (5.0 ft) pieces with one "///" text glyph every 18 pt along the line. The text layer holds 223 "///" glyphs, 222 on the plan (1 in the legend): 141 + 53 on the dry utilities, 17 on gas, 11 on water. Dry ticks 194 x 5.0 ft = 970 LF (-0.48%). Measured along the 7 dry-utility polylines themselves (chained in drawing order): 265.9 + 178.6 + 169.1 + 107.5 + 102.1 + 90.1 + 70.1 = 983.4 LF; the estimator is -1.8% under that. GPT-6 Astra, on zoomed crops, matches the three red north R/W traces to the three CAD runs west of the pole and finds that the estimator started one diagonal at the pole instead of at the TBX box, which explains a few feet of the shortfall. The telephone line is lumped into "power".

source: markup p64 bright-green linear "REMOVE EXISTING METAL HANDRAIL"
formula: LF = traced length along survey "METAL HANDRAIL" lines
notes: Traced along the survey linework labelled "METAL HANDRAIL": the edge of the walk from the steps to the ramp (30.2 ft), both sides of the north ramp (14.6 + 23.7 ft) and short pieces on both sides of the brick stair. CAD bracket: 68.5 LF without the stair sides and 79.6 LF with the full stair sides; 76.2 sits inside. No keynote, because the engineer did not keynote it; the estimator added it under GDN "all appurtenances".

description: KN4 remove existing storm sewer line - ASSUMED
source: markup p64 yellow linear "4: ... STORM SEWER LINE ... - ASSUMED" (under legend box)
formula: LF = traced length JB to HW
notes: Hidden under the PlanSwift legend on the markup. The line runs along the south property line, from the JB (TOP 438.35, I.E. OUT 434.75) to the HW 15" HDPE (TOP 438.00, I.E. IN 434.96). CAD: pipe line 105.37 LF, JB centre to HW centre 106.57 LF (+0.51%). "ASSUMED" because no KN4 tag is placed on the plan; keynote 4 exists only in the KEY NOTES list.
